resolution: Navigation and native theme controls retain readable labels, one preference selection, and the current preference during pending navigation or LiveView reconnect.
Denied/unavailable storage retains a functional current-page in-memory preference; invalid stored values select System. Navigation failure retains the existing shell and truthful connection feedback.
The rail becomes the existing drawer below 1280px; navigation/theme controls reflow without horizontal page overflow, hidden choice labels, or reduced targets.
Long navigation/accessibility labels wrap or reflow within the established rail/drawer/header rather than being clipped or obscuring the selected preference.
Zero configured schemas renders the Copywriting Contract configuration-empty guard and setup guidance, not zero-valued health claims.
During refresh, the shared busy control retains its icon and label; retained schema evidence keeps its previous successful snapshot and is not relabelled newly checked.
Check failure renders the Copywriting Contract observation-failure reason/retry path; unknown values never become zero or imply remote terminal failure.
Populated health uses existing summary/metric/schema groupings with neutral containers, explicit local states, Backend/Queue groups, and ordinary neutral zero-error counts.
Partial observations keep known values and retained failure history visible; each missing/unavailable source is labelled explicitly with its reason and retained-snapshot boundary.
Schema/index/task identifiers wrap in neutral surfaces; at desktop, mobile and changed breakpoints, content cannot create horizontal page overflow or clip essential evidence.
Zero schemas uses the configuration guard; one and many render the same established schema component, correct singular/plural counts, and 24px section/record rhythm without control-type changes.
Full module names, index identifiers and failure reasons remain readable and wrap; required instructions use body size and are not ellipsized into inaccessible metadata.
Busy quiet/refresh actions expose busy state while preserving their meaningful icon and label; hook completion and LiveView patches preserve server-driven eligibility.
An action failure presents the existing concrete failure/retry path and retains readable eligibility explanations; it cannot show success merely because an event was dispatched.
Quiet-action groups reflow within their container at narrow widths, retaining target sizes, independent focus rings and visible disabled explanations without page overflow.
Long action labels wrap/reflow without clipping the meaningful icon or label; essential explanations retain body sizing and no hover-only access.
Relative age stays tied to the successful evidence snapshot through pending refresh/copy; a pending clipboard write emits no success confirmation and does not re-date evidence.

Denied/unavailable clipboard access renders the Copywriting Contract persistent failure and exposes selectable exact evidence; a failed check retains the previous age reference and labels unavailable observation.
The native exact-timestamp disclosure and copy control reflow; full ISO precision/offset remains selectable by keyboard, pointer and touch without clipping or horizontal page overflow.
Long exact ISO values and UTC explanations wrap, never truncate fractional precision or source offset, and remain reachable without relying on a title tooltip.
Without logo/icon artwork, the accessible Scrypath name and accompanying explicit operational state/action labels remain usable; artwork cannot be the sole semantic cue.
Loading logo/icon assets retain bounded geometry and accompanying names/state labels; a loading asset cannot replace operational state with a spinner-only meaning.
Failed logo/icon assets leave the accessible product name and explicit operational labels available; missing artwork never turns an unknown/failure state into success.
Normal media uses existing theme-appropriate Scrypath wordmarks and Heroicons, with explicit labels; copper remains identity detail and semantic icons stay local.
Wordmarks/icons stay bounded to existing component geometry at every breakpoint and cannot force page overflow or cover nearby controls.
Long accompanying state/action labels wrap beside local icons without truncation; operational severity remains understandable through text even without color/artwork.
